# Gordon Greco LLC

> Fee-only fiduciary financial advisory — comprehensive wealth management for high-net-worth individuals, families, and business owners.

Gordon Greco LLC is a registered investment advisory firm founded by Markos Terzidis. The firm combines quantitative rigor with personalized advisory, specializing in tax-first thinking and cross-border US/Greece financial situations.

- [Home](https://hyperi0n1337.github.io/gordongreco.com/) — Overview of services, pricing, and custodian (Interactive Brokers)
- [About](https://hyperi0n1337.github.io/gordongreco.com/about.html) — Founder background, philosophy, and who the firm serves
- [Services](https://hyperi0n1337.github.io/gordongreco.com/services.html) — Overview of all five service pillars
- [Investment Management](https://hyperi0n1337.github.io/gordongreco.com/services/investment.html) — Tax-aware portfolio construction, risk management, quarterly reporting
- [Tax Strategy](https://hyperi0n1337.github.io/gordongreco.com/services/tax.html) — Year-round federal, state, AMT, and cross-border US/Greece tax planning
- [Retirement Planning](https://hyperi0n1337.github.io/gordongreco.com/services/retirement.html) — Contribution optimization, Social Security analysis, Monte Carlo simulations
- [Estate & Trust Planning](https://hyperi0n1337.github.io/gordongreco.com/services/estate.html) — Trust strategy, wealth transfer, special needs planning, legal coordination
- [Business Advisory](https://hyperi0n1337.github.io/gordongreco.com/services/business.html) — Entity structure, Solo 401(k), cash flow management for business owners
- [Contact](https://hyperi0n1337.github.io/gordongreco.com/contact.html) — Schedule a free 30-minute consultation; contact form

## Key Facts

- Fee structure: 1% of AUM annually (0.25% billed quarterly) for investment management; fee-based for advisory services
- Fiduciary: Yes — legally obligated to act in clients' best interest
- Fee-only: No commissions, no product sales
- Custodian: Interactive Brokers (IBKR)
- Specialty: Cross-border US/Greece tax situations, HNW families, business owners
- Contact: markos@gordongreco.com
- Schedule: https://cal.com/markos-terzidis-hicsb3/intro-call
